title.narrative: RISE - Benguet Project (Resilience, Innovation, Sustainability and Empowerment)

description.narrative: The Action envisions to support the development of a CSO network partner working alongside the LGUs putting into action participatory governance in the BLISTT and consequently be a multiplier effect on transformative change. The Action moves from community focused interventions to addressing systemic challenges faced by accredited CSOs and LGUs in working towards participatory governance. To stimulate cooperation and a strong acknowledgement of each other¿s relevance in participatory governance, LGU partnership agreements with the Action will commit to supplemental resource sharing when co-implementing resilient projects.
